inputs.content: Neutral substrate: methyl 2-oxo-1-(2-phenylallyl)cyclopentane-1-carboxylate. In the ring numbering used by this name, C1 bears both methoxycarbonyl (CO2Me) and CH2–C(phenyl)=CH2 substituents, and C2 bears the ketone oxo group. No enantiopure starting configuration is specified.
Substrate 0.20 mmol, thioxanthone (9H-thioxanthen-9-one) 10 mol%, DMSO 2 mL, nitrogen, approximately 395 nm 10 W LED irradiation, room temperature, 3 h.

The reaction affords methyl 5-oxo-7-phenylbicyclo[5.1.0]octane-1-carboxylate in 99% isolated yield. The methoxycarbonyl substituent at bridgehead C1 and phenyl substituent at bridgehead C7 lie on the same face of the cyclopropane ring (cis relative configuration); absolute configuration is unspecified.
